findings.description: `is_deposit_paused` (via `is_market_paused`) now returns `true` (paused) when the persistent pause-flags map is missing. If the pause key is ever absent due to TTL expiry/archival restore or migration mistakes, markets can become globally paused, potentially freezing user actions that depend on these pause checks until state is repaired.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the pause-flags key TTL is reliably extended (or re-initialized) in keeper/admin flows, or explicitly initialize missing pause metadata to an empty map during setup/migration rather than treating absence as a permanent pause.
findings.title: Contract Lifecycle & State: missing pause metadata hard-pauses markets in `is_deposit_paused`

findings.description: `deposit` now requires `PermanentMinimumSupply >= 1_000` for any market where `minimum_cash_reserve_bps()` returns `Some(_)`, but the only way to set `PermanentMinimumSupply` (`seed_minimum_supply`) requires an *empty* market (zero supply/underlying/borrow). In non-`lp-engine` builds, `minimum_cash_reserve_bps()` returns `Some(10_000)` even when `MinCashReserveBps` is absent, so legacy/unconfigured deployed markets can start reverting on every deposit after upgrade with no recovery path.
findings.recommendation: Gate the `cash market must be explicitly seeded` assertion to only apply when `total_ptokens_supply == 0` (i.e., first-deposit protection), or only when `PermanentMinimumSupply` is explicitly configured. Alternatively provide an admin migration method that can safely set a floor for non-empty markets, or keep `MinCashReserveBps` absence as `None` for legacy instances.
findings.title: Business Logic: deposits can be permanently bricked in `deposit`
